ideas.pitch: A training-free, self-improving semantic query router for AI coding agent requests.
ideas.title: VibeRouter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts proven architecture from past hackathon winners like darwin-router to handle fast semantic routing, scoring high on technical difficulty during a tight overnight sprint.

ideas.pitch: A BPMN-orchestrated pre-deployment risk diagnosis tool for autonomous AI workflows.
ideas.title: AgentBPMN Guard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages structural workflow orchestration and human-in-the-loop patterns that consistently impress judges looking for robust agent governance.

ideas.pitch: An offline AI code reviewer optimized for running locally on hardware NPUs and constrained environments.
ideas.title: EdgeDebug AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on local execution and performance efficiency, mirroring the runner-up strategy of Qualcomm Snapdragon Multiverse Hackathon entries.

ideas.pitch: An adversarial simulation environment where two identical AI negotiation agents discover cooperative strategies autonomously.
ideas.title: SplitAgent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates emergent behavior and adversarial AI dynamics without hardcoded rules, an approach that secured first place at the Datadog Self-Improving Agents Hack.

ideas.pitch: A zero-config auto-embedding and lightweight RAG toolkit designed for rapid database-backed prototyping.
ideas.title: AutoEmbed RAG Toolkit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves developer friction directly with a practical tool that hackathon judges can immediately test and appreciate during live demos.
